infile.scope: Read complex DATA or float total-power input from the required MeasurementSet.

radius.scope: Use the supplied angular quantity, arcsecond number, or the default half primary-beam size.

smooth.scope: Smooth reference powers in the central time series before normalizing them.

field.scope: Select fields and their tracking centers.

spw.scope: Select one scalar gain channel in each requested spectral window.

scan.scope: Select requested scan rows before selecting the central region.

intent.scope: Filter observing intents only when the caller supplies a selector.

applytable.scope: Apply supplied prior calibration tables in the shared native solver path.

interp.scope: Use one interpolation for all tables or align entries by table index.

spwmap.scope: Use the same flat window map for all priors or configure each prior table.

outfile.scope: Write a CASA-readable complex SDGAIN_OTFD calibration table, including a valid empty table when some integrations reach the solver but the group is short.

overwrite.scope: Replace an existing calibration table or separate MeasurementSet when requested and keep its contents when no solution reaches the solver.

behaviors.title: Double-circle reference integrations
behaviors.scope: Resolve CASA selectors, central regions, antenna pointing interpolation, and scalar frequency selection.
behaviors.gap: Release and dataset-scale benchmarks follow functionality under #979.

behaviors.title: Flag-aware gain normalization
behaviors.scope: Use the selected good samples to normalize gains by the group mean, preserving CASA per-receptor complex values and flags.
behaviors.gap: Release and dataset-scale benchmarks follow functionality under #979.

behaviors.title: Per-table prior calibration
behaviors.scope: Apply time-varying priors to complex or real single-dish data. Mapped Tsys uses CASA's station order and Float rounding, with scalar and indexed interpolation and window lists.
behaviors.gap: Release and dataset-scale benchmarks follow functionality under #979.

behaviors.title: Complex calibration table interoperability
behaviors.scope: Write standard compatible subtables and preserve the complex gain and selected spectral axis for CASA or native application.
behaviors.gap: Release and dataset-scale benchmarks follow functionality under #979.

decisions.inputs: Select two channels of a three-channel total-power spectral window for a double-circle gain solve.
decisions.casa: Aborts while copying a two-channel spectrum into a scalar solve cell.
decisions.ours: Returns a catchable error and preserves existing files before publication.
decisions.rationale: Selecting one channel produces the defined scalar gain shape.
decisions.impact: A caller can select one channel and rerun without restarting Python.

decisions.inputs: Move the field reference outside the observed map so the pointing filter finds no central integration.
decisions.casa: Segfaults while constructing time ranges from the empty selection.
decisions.ours: Returns a catchable solve error and preserves existing files.
decisions.rationale: No central integration is available to normalize gain.
decisions.impact: A caller can adjust the radius or field and rerun safely.

paired.kind: Same-input public CASA/native comparisons, independent gain laws and both-direction table interchange
paired.scope: All named task parameters, default and selected radius, smoothing, variable/mapped priors, flags, input types, reordered rows, mixed feed/window selection and publication.
paired.result: The public oracle matches complex table cells, scalar frequencies, flagged selected rows, and outputs from both table readers. It checks no-output and short-group publication separately and exercises two CASA crash cases in isolated processes.

stock.scope: Official double-circle maps, explicit replacement, separate and combined sky and Tsys priors on FLOAT_DATA, SPW mapping and single polarization.
stock.result: All 13 cases passed on each Python implementation without skips. The applied gain tables also passed the paired writer-reader comparison.
